_about: Level 2 eval (scripts/eval.py --l2): scripted chats sent to frontline.chat one user turn at a time (stops after a handoff), fresh session id each run, Adapty writes disabled (a grant the code allows is counted as 'allowed', i.e. would grant). Scored on what the code did, not on the wording: `grant` = 'allowed' (some grant_access call allowed) | 'blocked:<policy reason>' (only blocked calls; first reason) | 'none' (no grant_access call); `handoff` = the handoff reason, null = no handoff, 'any' = not scored. A list means any of these values. `setup.prior_grant` writes a grant row into the scratch DB before the chat (what v2 would have recorded for the earlier grant). Profiles = cached in data/demo.sqlite on Sat 7 Nov; config = models.AgentConfig() defaults (max_days 7, 1 grant per 30 days, require_paid).
